changelog: **/admin/ai — AI usage, spend, quota and provider status (#2030):** `GET /api/admin/ai/usage` (`?month=YYYY-MM`, default the current month, plus the month before) returns calls per task split into ok / `parse_error` / `provider_error`, input and output tokens, list-price spend (with a count of answered calls whose model is unpriced, so the spend reads as a floor) and nearest-rank p50/p95 latency, aggregated in SQL (one `groupBy` per month plus two indexed `skip` lookups per task — never a month of rows); `?format=csv` exports that month's metered calls (meter columns only: no user, no content). `GET /api/admin/ai/status` says whether a provider key is configured (never which), the model each registry task resolves to, this process's circuit-breaker state and the 30-day count of calls flagged by the prompt-injection tripwire (#2026). Both are ADMIN-only at the route and scoped to the admin's org with `orgWhere()`, the same rows the quota counts. The page has an editable quota card (0 = AI off), per-task tables for both months, provider status, the model table and the CSV link; sidebar entry "AI usage". `/api/health`'s detail block gains `ai: 'ok' | 'not_configured'`. The settings hint no longer claims AI usage is metered install-wide — it is per organisation.

en: Admins get an AI usage screen: calls, failures and spend per AI feature for this and last month, the monthly AI budget you can change in place, and whether the AI provider is connected.
tr: Yöneticiler için AI kullanım ekranı: bu ay ve geçen ay her AI özelliği için çağrılar, hatalar ve harcama, yerinde değiştirilebilen aylık AI bütçesi ve AI sağlayıcısının bağlı olup olmadığı.
de: Admins erhalten eine Übersicht zur KI-Nutzung: Aufrufe, Fehler und Ausgaben je KI-Funktion für diesen und den letzten Monat, das monatliche KI-Budget zum direkten Ändern und ob der KI-Anbieter angebunden ist.
